intentAndPurpose.intent: Visual separator between sections, list items, or content groups.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Multi-accent role. 'auto' inherits the nearest Surface appearance, then falls back to neutral.

props.name: aria-hidden
props.description: Hide the separator from assistive technology when it is purely decorative.

props.name: attention
props.description: Prominence level — drives stroke tier and centre Icon/Text emphasis. Default: 'low'

props.name: children
props.description: Centre content — plain string/number (auto-wrapped in Label XS Medium `<Text />`), `<Icon />`, or `<Text />`. Divider merges `appearance` / `attention` onto `Icon` / `Text` when those props are unset on the child. Omit for a bare separator. Figma `slot` mapping (no React `slot` prop): - omit / empty → `none` - `<Icon />` → `icon` - string / `<Text />` → `label`

props.name: contentAlign
props.description: Position of the centre content. Default: 'center'

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test automation id — forwarded to the root separator element only.

props.name: size
props.description: Stroke width of the divider. Default: 'm'

interactionBehavior.summary: Divider is a presentational separator (`role="separator"` via Base UI, or a `role="separator"` div when it has centre content). It has no hover, press, or focus styles, is not in the tab order, and does not handle keys. Colour comes from attention × appearance tokens on the stroke (and centre text/icon); those do not change on pointer or keyboard. Do not wrap it in a button — put actions beside it.
